d.ko: Stoneshard is a hardcore turn-based RPG about the harsh life of a medieval mercenary: travel with your own caravan, descend into procedurally generated dungeons, learn new skills, survive hunger and injuries - and remember, every mistake can mean death and loss of progress.
d.en: Stoneshard is a hardcore turn-based RPG about the harsh life of a medieval mercenary: travel with your own caravan, descend into procedurally generated dungeons, learn new skills, survive hunger and injuries - and remember, every mistake can mean death and loss of progress.
d.zh: 《紫色晶石》作为硬核回合制角色扮演游戏，旨在展现中世纪雇佣兵的艰苦生活。与你的车队一同游历各地，深入程序生成的地城，学习技能，捱过饥饿与伤痛的折磨。务必记住，生死就在一步之间，一步错，就有可能前功尽弃。
